infobox.effect: Provides 64 inventory slots while only taking up 9

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Mr. Holodilnick thermal bag is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in a 8x8 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Provisions
- Can of Majaica coffee beans
- Can of Dr. Lupo's coffee beans
- 42 Signature Blend English Tea
- Pack of Arseniy buckwheat

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Easter eggs and References:
  - It refers to the content creator "Mr. Holodilnick"
  - Holodilnick (Холодильник) can be translated from Russian to "Refrigerator"
  - The Mr. Holodilnick thermal bag is modeled after the Mobicool S32
